description: Headless Python script that modifies or filters the NIfTI volumes of a BIDS dataset (e.g. intensity threshold or Gaussian smoothing), optionally guided by a NeuroVue correction patch, and writes the filtered volumes to the session output directory.

bids_dir.description: BIDS dataset whose anatomical volumes are filtered.

correction_patch.description: Optional NeuroVue correction patch that parameterizes the filter.

amount.description: Operation magnitude (FWHM mm for smooth, intensity for threshold).

block.label: Filter Volumes (Python)
block.description: Apply a NIfTI filter operation with a Python script.

requirements: Python 3.10+ with nibabel and numpy (scipy optional, for faster smoothing); set NEUROFLOW_PYTHON to the environment
neuroflow/launch.description: python_tool.mjs checks the Python environment, then calls nf_filter_volumes.run(bids_dir, operation, amount), which writes the filtered volumes to $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR/filtered and appends a provenance line.
